# EZLONG

> EZLONG (ezlong.com) is a free, no-signup toolbox for long-term US stock investors, built by an individual Korean investor. It offers AI-powered market signals, chart analysis, and a suite of calculators/simulators for DCA (dollar-cost averaging), compounding, retirement planning, and tax-advantaged accounts. Korean is the primary language; an English version lives under /en/.

Data updates: market signals refresh every 30 minutes on US trading days, AI chart analysis hourly, and the positive-vs-negative market scorecard five times daily. All analysis text is diagnostic (no imperative "buy now" advice).

## Tools (Korean)

- [스윙 시그널 대시보드](https://ezlong.com/atmr-dashboard.html): AI swing-trading signal for QQQ/VOO/SOXX with buy/sell scores, 3-3-4 split-entry strategy guide, and TSLA·NVDA focused analysis
- [긍정 vs 부정 몇대몇](https://ezlong.com/market-vs.html): AI market scorecard — positive vs negative factors ratio, updated 5x daily
- [AI 차트분석](https://ezlong.com/chart-analysis.html): technical chart analysis (RSI, MACD, Bollinger) for 50+ US stocks, ETFs, and crypto
- [월가 목표주가](https://ezlong.com/analyst-reports.html): Wall Street analyst target price consensus for major tech stocks
- [마켓 사이클](https://ezlong.com/market-cycle.html): weekly-candle market cycle monitor for downtrend inflection detection
- [심플 주가](https://ezlong.com/stocks.html): simple real-time price board for 200+ US tickers
- [DCA 시뮬레이터](https://ezlong.com/dca-simulator.html): dollar-cost averaging compound return simulator
- [백테스트](https://ezlong.com/backtest.html): Monte Carlo portfolio simulator
- [은퇴 계산기](https://ezlong.com/retirement-calculator.html): retirement goal reverse calculator
- [절세 계좌](https://ezlong.com/tax-account-simulator.html): Korean tax-advantaged account (ISA/연금저축/IRP) after-tax simulator
- [복리 계산기](https://ezlong.com/compound-calculator.html): compound interest calculator
